list: Official 55-trophy PS5 list, 1 platinum / 2 gold / 6 silver / 46 bronze, 28 hidden, as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (Nov 2026)
honesty: The game released 19 Nov 2026 and PowerPyx published a full trophy guide with in-game-verified steps on launch day, so most guides below are built from those verified steps, rewritten here in our own words and cited by name. A few trophies are still unconfirmed (notably Bad Luck, I Guess) and this guide says so plainly instead of inventing a method. Trophy names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them.

sourceList.label: PlanetGTA6 — all 55 trophies, visible vs hidden

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is no separate job behind the platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so the whole guide is the method. PowerPyx rates the full run at roughly 200 hours and a 4 out of 10 difficulty, with a single playthrough enough and no online trophies anywhere on the list. Work the six stages in order — story, side strands, collectibles, activities, money and mayhem, then the 100% completion gold — and tick each trophy off here as it pops. The one standing warning for the whole run also comes from PowerPyx: cheats switch trophies off and block saving, so keep this save clean. Sources for the shape of the run: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap, and the Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the first main mission of Chapter 1, and the trophy pops as soon as you finish it — PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed, and the Exophase and PSNProfiles lists agree on the wording. There is nothing to prepare and no choice to get wrong: follow the mission markers, finish the job, and this is the first bronze on the board. Because the story has no mission replay, PowerPyx suggests keeping manual saves at the start and end of each chapter (15 slots are available) — good hygiene for the run, though nothing in this opening mission can lock you out. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this pops — PowerPyx notes it actually lands just after the chapter closes, when the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, is done. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the one thing in the whole game that can go away: the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it as the only possibly missable trophy, tied to a morning after the Down to Earth mission, and neither can yet confirm whether it is required — so do it while you can and stop worrying about it. Sources: PowerPyx's trophy guide and meditation guide; GTABase's trophy guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles lists.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. PowerPyx places this one the same way as the last: it pops when the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, is finished, which is how the game marks the chapter turning over. Chapter 2 is also where two-character play opens up — after the Coffee Break mission you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which matters for the meditation spots, the partner trophies and the strength trophy later. Use the chapter to scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel; PowerPyx counts 277 base-model vehicles and the 100% checklist wants 200 of them scanned, so early scanning is free progress. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx reports this chapter trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 — Ocean Beach and Another Life — so do not be surprised if it lands a little after you think the chapter ended. By now Vice City itself is open, which unlocks the bulk of the side content: Andy's Lucia-only strand starts in Chapter 3, Randy's car wishlist opens after the Clonin' Keys mission, and Yasmani's jewelry jobs unlock the Snap Gun and the jewelry-store robberies. Sweep new areas as they open rather than leaving the whole map for the endgame; the vehicle, card and WAiNK It counts all grow while you explore. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. PowerPyx places this trophy at the end of the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero — the same mission that also pops the gold for finishing the story, so the two land together. Before that final mission, check the side strands that opened in this chapter: Child's Play, Headliners and the VCIA Takedown are all Chapter 4 missions with their own trophies, and the optional bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is… starts here too. Nothing in Chapter 4 can be missed for trophy purposes — the strands and the vaults stay available in free roam after the story. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. PowerPyx names it as Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4, and lists it as an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed. Finishing the story is only the halfway point for the platinum, though: the gold A Long Road still needs the 100% completion checklist, and PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at around 200 hours with the story itself taking 60 to 80 of those. After the credits you keep free roam and the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and nothing on it is missable, so the endgame is a cleanup, not a second playthrough. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. PowerPyx puts this mission in Chapter 2, and lists the trophy as automatic and unmissable — finish the mission and it pops. There is no grade, no optional objective and no preparation tied to it; just play the story in order and the mission arrives. If you are tracking the run, this is one of the early Chapter 2 story trophies, so it should land well before the two-character switch in Coffee Break that opens up the partner and meditation content. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. PowerPyx places this heist in Chapter 3 and lists it as automatic and unmissable. It is one of the Chapter 3 story beats alongside Welcome to Vice City, which opens the chapter, so it lands early in the middle of the story rather than near the end. Heist missions run long, so set aside a full session rather than starting it with ten minutes to spare. Completion is all the trophy asks — there is no grade or optional objective attached — and the mission is a story beat, so it cannot be skipped or failed permanently; a failed attempt just restarts the mission. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. PowerPyx places this one in Chapter 4 and lists it as automatic and unmissable, so the advice is simply to keep playing the story in order until it arrives. It sits in the same chapter as Headliners and the VCIA Takedown, and the chapter closes with Starting From Zero, so by the time this pops you are deep into the late story. No side content gates it and no preparation helps it — finish the mission once and the trophy is yours. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. PowerPyx places it in Chapter 4 and lists it as automatic and unmissable. Like the other mission trophies it pops on completion, with no grade or optional objective. It arrives in the same late-story stretch as Child's Play and the VCIA Takedown, shortly before the final mission, so if you are ticking the story trophies off in order this is one of the last bronzes before the gold for finishing the story. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. PowerPyx places it in Chapter 4 and lists it as automatic and unmissable. The airport matters beyond this mission: it is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens, stealing a docked passenger plane from a departure terminal, so remember the layout — the E3/E4 terminals are the ones PowerPyx points to for the easiest plane. For this trophy itself, finishing the mission once is enough. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx places this mission in Chapter 5 — the story runs to five chapters, not four — and lists the trophy as automatic and unmissable. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies, arriving after the final-mission gold, so treat it as the story's epilogue beat rather than part of the main climb. It comes after Starting From Zero, the Chapter 4 final mission, so by the time it pops the story is nearly done and free roam is fully open. Finish the mission and it pops; nothing else gates it. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, and PowerPyx stresses that nothing on it is missable. The requirements are far more forgiving than the name suggests — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions (there are 200 to 300+), 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Clear it category by category with the planner here, and the platinum follows on its own. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and 100% checklist notes; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total across four kinds — 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix the kinds freely to reach 250. Under the Bridges is the quickest to grind, and every stunt has its own name and stays marked on the map once done, so you can track them from Map, Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy rather than stopping at 250. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and stunt guides; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. PowerPyx counts 9 activity types, and the in-game tracker lives under Touchpad, Progress, Activities: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Most of these arrive on their own while you work through the other trophies, and PowerPyx expects the trophy to land automatically during a normal 100% run — so do not chase it early; just check the Activities screen late in the run and mop up whichever type is still at zero. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PowerPyx maps 12 shooting range locations holding those 42 challenges, and gold is per challenge — replay any that fall short one at a time, in any order, at your own pace. The ranges also feed your Focus level, which the Gunslinger trophy needs, so the time here pays twice. Track each challenge's medal from the range itself; there is no single run to perfect and no missable window. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and shooting-range guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 drone races across those 14 spots, and winning a location once is enough — no repeats after a win. Learn one course at a time rather than grinding the same track, and check the Top Fun activity menu in-game for the locations still unwon. If one course keeps beating you, move to a different location: each location's win counts on its own, so there is no need to master a single track before moving on. All 42 races are also on the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist move together. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and drone-race guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, and the key word is different — repeating a win on the same course does nothing for the count, so work through the race list and keep a note of which ones you have already won. Use the fastest vehicle you own for each race, and remember these wins also feed the 100% checklist and the Master of None activity count. A win on a course you have already won does not count twice, so if the trophy has not popped, check the race list for the ones you have not tried yet rather than replaying a favorite. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and race guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The chain starts after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal — PowerPyx reports that Cal then sends a text that marks a fishing spot on the map with a purple icon, opening his fishing questline. Follow that line of quests to the head-to-head challenge and win it once; the trophy pops on the win. Fishing itself is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, and it raises your Focus, so the questline is worth doing even before the challenge. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are 4 video games in GTA 6, which PowerPyx lists as Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and the fourth sits on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge, just reach the end — and any of the four counts, so pick the one you enjoy most. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and video-game guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her strand is exclusive to Lucia and starts in Chapter 3: PowerPyx reports that Andy calls Lucia at some point in the chapter, then texts her home address in Belville, which marks the questline on the map. The strand runs five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain in three parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and all of it stays available after the story, so there is no rush. Finish the last one and the trophy pops. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His strand starts in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission where you work for him; PowerPyx reports he then calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks, marking purple chest icons on the map — find the wrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 to 3 (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up, per PowerPyx), so do not worry if he vanishes for a while. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and PowerPyx lists five quests in it: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of it stays available after the story, so the strand is safe to leave until the endgame cleanup if you prefer — just work the five jobs in the order Billy hands them out, and the trophy pops when the last one, Hometown Heroes, is done. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx is explicit that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy, so do not waste the count on them. The strands PowerPyx confirms do count are Kirk's skunk-ape hunts (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's farm jobs (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago's racing mentorship (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete's deliveries (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, then his delivery runs). More strangers are still being found, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and strangers guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His wishlist opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Granforma Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner; PowerPyx reports he then wants 16 sports cars delivered, from the Pegassi Vitello and Infernus to the Grotti Itali RSX and Bravado Banshee. Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, and deliver to his garage at the green RK icon in west Vice City — a car in good condition pays more. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted before you steal it; the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach is where PowerPyx says the high-end cars park. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only: PowerPyx reports purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear across Vice City, and the first quest, Take Out Kitty Litter, has you destroying them. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. Tyrone's is one of the two Jason-only strands in Stage 2, alongside Bret's Target Decks, so do both while you are working the Jason-only quests. Everything stays available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations across 10 spots, per PowerPyx: each spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there, and the last spot only appears once the rest are done. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The one step that can go away is the first one: in Chapter 1, the morning after the Down to Earth mission, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house, then walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy, and neither can yet confirm whether it is required, so do it while Chapter 1 lasts. The final meditation needs both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Sources: PowerPyx's trophy guide and meditation-spot guide; GTABase's trophy guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His strand opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: PowerPyx reports that while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive it, so this strand is Jason-only. Do that quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals he requests back to him. On the first quest he hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. Track the hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks and all of them are on the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally with that work. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. PowerPyx counts 18 card sets in total across Leonida, and you only need any 3 of them — so pick the sets whose cards you find first and keep collecting as you explore; there is no requirement to complete every set. Cards turn up while you sweep the map for the other collectibles, so this pairs naturally with the WAiNK It and vehicle-discovery trophies. Use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are closest to complete, and finish the three nearest rather than chasing a set whose cards are scattered. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and card-set guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app scans things in the world — hold up on the D-pad, then R1, while looking at them — and PowerPyx breaks the scannables into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags, with more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Fold scanning into exploring: every new place you visit has something to scan, and the same app is how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good and check Randy's wishlist cars. The in-game map can filter for these under Exploration. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. PowerPyx counts 80 challenges in total and you only need 50 for this trophy — and the 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress, Challenges, where each one shows a completed tick; many finish on their own while you chase the other trophies, so leave this for late in the run and then pick the easiest of what remains. You can skip the hardest ten entirely, which is the whole point of the 50-of-80 design. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and challenges guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle, then cause enough carnage to reach 4 stars. PowerPyx's escape tip is to take a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic, or drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, which always triggers 4 stars. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when you can call your partner (hold right, press triangle). The trick is keeping the flashing wanted level alive between robberies — move fast between three nearby shops, and if the heat drops, the chain breaks and you start again. PowerPyx points to the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3: rob a couple of items in each, break the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and keep going to a fourth shop if the trophy has not popped — it lands about half a minute after you leave the third shop. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA 6 has 557 vehicles at launch, and PowerPyx's method is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning alone registers the discovery, you do not need to drive anything. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes, and the count climbs fast; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this trophy lands on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming, and it slows time and highlights weak spots while it drains the purple focus bar — so the window is short. PowerPyx's setup: buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash and shower at home, pop Adrenaline to stretch the slow-motion, wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation, and line up five enemies close together at a gang operation with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a gang fight. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and it gets easier as you level it. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. PowerPyx's method: steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — the ones on the open airfield do not count — and the easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4, reached by driving through a fence around the airfield or walking through the terminal. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are clear. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke, not an instruction — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — but PowerPyx pins the action down: steal a military tank, a Rhino, from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy military response, so go in with full armor and a plan to leave fast once it unlocks. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks the jewelry-store robberies on the map. PowerPyx's method: break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm — then leave clean. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the spot PowerPyx uses; if you are spotted, the attempt fails but the store can be robbed again. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. This opens with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which marks itself on the map: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in while it is open, grab the cash, and bring your partner so you can hand off a bag. After that quest, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (once you have done his earlier jobs, including two Payday Loan robberies), marking the vans purple. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and you need any 5 here, but all 8 for the 100% checklist, each paying up to $205,000 — and every vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognizable. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and bank-vault guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The surest route is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that opens the bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. If you want it earlier, PowerPyx gives a free-roam method — find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are sold in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PowerPyx's method is to unfog the whole map, and the fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the map is fully visible. Do it once the whole state is open and pair it with the other exploration trophies — scanning vehicles and WAiNK spots and picking up cards all happen on the same sweep, and the Exophase and PSNProfiles lists count 52 areas to discover. Use the in-game map to spot the areas you have not set foot in yet. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and map guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. PowerPyx counts 39 illegal gang operations in total, and this trophy needs just one per gang — but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it lands automatically if you clear them all. Operations get yellow map icons as you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress; track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs, where scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and gang-operation guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx names the spot: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, where you buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — one drink, one view. It sits on the watch list here only because some location trophies are tied to a story visit, but PowerPyx lists it as doable in free roam, so walk Ocean Beach, find the rooftop bar and order the martini. Pair it with the card sets and WAiNK scans on the same Ocean Beach sweep — one stop on the route, not a trip of its own. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx pins this to one specific car: the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City, an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the showroom window. The trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are further down the street; any other car will not do it. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. PowerPyx explains this one is a robbery, not a game of bowling: during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations — steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought at an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and you do not need to take all three in one visit: if the robbery icon respawns later you can come back for the ones you missed. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. PowerPyx decodes the riddle: this pops when both Jason and Lucia have maximum strength at the same time, checked under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks switching between the two. Raise strength by working out — buy a gym membership, filter for fitness clubs on Map, Activities — and always bring your partner along (hold right, press triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other finishes their training automatically, doubling progress. You can also work out at home after the story. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PowerPyx reports the trophy tracks 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count — and turning on criminal-profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications) shows a small demon face whenever an action registers. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians) and Irredeemable, which is permanent if you keep using excessive violence — PowerPyx warns to avoid that one, since cops get far more aggressive. Most players earn this passively across the other trophies; if you are short at the end, robberies and enemy encounters all count. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is the one trophy PowerPyx still lists as unknown: the current belief is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no verified method exists yet, so this guide will not invent one. The wording suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure — so if an activity fails once, try it again immediately rather than moving on — but treat that as a reading of the description, not a confirmed step. Check back here and at the cited guides as the method is confirmed; until then, do not grind for it. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide (trophy listed as unknown); Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx traces this to the UFO easter egg: go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO's bright blue light in the sky; approach it and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks — the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random, so this one takes patience, not skill. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx gives the exact method: ride any motorcycle or push bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas are the place to do it — Vice City or Ocean Beach — and a slow, steady ride through a crowd beats a fast one, since you need ten kicks inside the minute. Pick a bike you can steer precisely rather than the fastest one you own, and ride along a busy sidewalk or beachfront where pedestrians bunch together; each kick that connects counts toward the ten. It can be retried in free roam as often as you like, so if the minute runs out, just find another crowd and go again. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — PowerPyx reports that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 counts across all your robberies, not in one trip, and the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so this builds naturally while you clear the robbery trophies. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts and the total is cumulative, so buy weapons, clothes, food and upgrades as you play and it climbs on its own. If you reach the endgame short of the total, PowerPyx's fastest method is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 11 tattoo studios and more across Leonida, so there is never a shortage of places to spend. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PowerPyx counts 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story-related ones that do not count), costing $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through the app. Buy each one as you find it; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover, and you need garage parking spots before you can register 10 vehicles for the Scooter Bros trophy. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and garage guide; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses — PowerPyx reports he then lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register; each garage you own adds parking spots for more registrations, so buy the garages first. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes. Sources: PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide and roadmap; Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists.
